data.root_cause: UNIT_MULTIPLIERS['h'] was set to 60 (treating hours as minutes) instead of 3600 (seconds per hour). This caused parse_duration('1h30m') to compute 1*60 + 30 = 90 instead of the correct 1*3600 + 30*60 = 5400.
